title: Iván Jesús Barrera Olivera
text:
Iván Jesús Barrera Olivera
Expert in Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning · Public Policy Consultant · Data Analyst
Over 20 years designing evaluation systems and generating evidence for decision-making in international organizations, federal and state governments, and civil society. I combine methodological rigor with data analysis tools (R, Python, SQL, KoboToolbox) to produce actionable knowledge that improves social interventions.

title: Professional Experience
text:
Consulting & research



Monitoring & Evaluation Coordinator
GEF Agriculture and Biodiversity in Mexico Project — SADER · IFAD 2024 – 2026

Facilitated the Theory of Change with key partners: INAES, CIMMYT, COLPOS, FIRA, SADER, and CONAFOR.
Designed the M&E Plan: indicator matrix, technical sheets, and KoboToolbox data collection instruments.
Developed the project’s Knowledge Management Plan across three axes: creation, use, and enabling conditions.



Director of Evaluation Projects
Politeia Consultores en Evaluación 2003 – present

Over 30 evaluations and studies for civil society organizations, state governments, federal government, and international organizations.
Clients include: CONEVAL, SEDESOL, SEDATU, IFT, UNICEF, UNESCO, UNDP, World Bank, among others.
Specialization in design, process, results, and impact evaluations of social programs.



Monitoring & Evaluation Coordinator
GEF Mexican Agrobiodiversity Project — CONABIO · FAO 2019 – 2023

Designed and implemented the M&E system for five regional coordinators.
Co-developed an interactive monitoring dashboard using R/Shiny, published on shinyapps.io.
Systematized implementation experiences across the project’s territorial units.
Trained regional teams in data collection instrument use and data gathering procedures.



Research Director / Associate Researcher
Mexicanos Primero 2009 – 2015

Coordinated the first State of Education in Mexico report: Against the Wall (2009).
Co-authored the Inclusive Educational Performance Index (IDEI), published annually 2009–2013 and adopted in state education policy.
Led the first study on the FAEB, underpinning the Where Is My Teacher? campaign and influencing the federal budget.



Monitoring & Evaluation Coordinator
GEF Gulf of Mexico Large Marine Ecosystem Project — SEMARNAT · UNIDO 2008 – 2009

Developed the indicator matrix, technical sheets, and data collection instruments.
Trained regional partners in data collection and information gathering.



External Consultant

Authored three guides in the Municipal Regulatory Improvement Collection.
